description: Na₃MnO₄ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.17 Å) and three longer (2.36 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. Mn is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and three longer (1.73 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mn atom.
